name: Langhe Nebbiolo
terms: Denominazione di Origine Controllata. The label names a precise area, and the wine is tested during production.

blurb.text: A wine of the Langhe DOC in Piedmont, at least 85% Nebbiolo. Nebbiolo is the grape behind Barolo and Barbaresco, the region's best-known wines.
